item.title: LangHUD 0.2.0
item.description:
### Added
- Auto-correct as you type: an optional setting that fixes words typed in the wrong keyboard language as you go. - Convert text without selecting it first: with nothing selected, the shortcut converts the line you are on. - A new way to trigger a conversion: double-tap a modifier key. - LangHUD stays quiet while Do Not Disturb or a Focus is on. - Set a keyboard layout per app. - More reminder looks, per language.
### Changed
- Settings take effect immediately. - A tidier menu-bar menu and Settings window. - Smaller fixes and polish throughout.

item.title: LangHUD 0.1.0
item.description:
### Added
- A small on-screen reminder shows which keyboard language you are typing in when you start typing in a text field, switch apps, or come back to typing after a pause. - An optional spoken cue says the language name, for example "English" or "Hebrew". - The menu bar icon shows the current keyboard language. - Fix the last typed text: select text that was typed in the wrong keyboard language and press the hot key to convert it to the other language and switch the keyboard to match. - Settings for the reminder, the spoken cue, the hot key and starting at login. - A Known Limitations window that lists apps where LangHUD cannot see typing. - A 14-day free trial from the first launch. After it the spoken cue and text correction need a license; the on-screen reminder stays free. Reinstalling the app does not restart the trial. - LangHUD can now check for updates and offer them (never forced). A new version shows in the menu bar icon's menu; "Check for Updates…" is there too.
